name: ui-code-block
description: CodeBlock — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui code-block pattern).

schema.description: CodeBlock — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui code-block pattern).
schema.name: ui-code-block

editable.description: When true, render an editable surface that composes a transparent `Textarea` over a Prism-highlighted overlay. The overlay re-tokenizes on each keystroke (driven from a local mirror of the textarea value), so users see syntax-highlighted code while still being able to type. Folding is skipped in editable mode. History: GAP-51 first-cut shipped plain (no-highlighting) editable text; GAP-77 (2026-04-12) added the Prism overlay layer. Default: false (existing read-only behavior unchanged).
editable.label: Editable

editorId.description: Stable identity for the keyboard router / plugin host to target this editor. Unset = this instance never receives capability events.
editorId.label: Editor Id

foldable.description: Enable brace-based code folding of multi-line `{}`/`[]` blocks (default: true).
foldable.label: Foldable

language.description: Programming language for syntax highlighting (any Prism id; loaded on demand if not pre-registered)
language.label: Language

motions.description: Motion vocabulary this editor accepts. Default: the full `EditorMotion` set.
motions.label: Motions

newValue.description: New source text — generates diff when combined with oldValue
newValue.label: New Value

oldValue.description: Old source text — generates diff when combined with newValue
oldValue.label: Old Value

onChange.description: GAP-51: called with the new code on every keystroke when `editable === true`. Consumers should debounce + parse downstream — `CodeBlock` does not.
onChange.label: On Change

onEditorBlur.description: Declarative bus emit fired when this editor loses focus.
onEditorBlur.label: On Editor Blur

onEditorFocus.description: Declarative bus emit fired when this editor gains focus.
onEditorFocus.label: On Editor Focus

onInsertText.description: Declarative bus listen: insert literal text at the cursor.
onInsertText.label: On Insert Text

onMotion.description: Declarative bus listen: move the cursor per the vim-style motion vocabulary.
onMotion.label: On Motion

onOperate.description: Declarative bus listen: apply a text operator over a motion's range.
onOperate.label: On Operate

onSetMode.description: Declarative bus listen: switch editor mode and caret style.
onSetMode.label: On Set Mode

operators.description: Operator vocabulary this editor accepts. Default: the full `EditorOperator` set.

showCopy.description: Show copy button (viewer alias for showCopyButton)

showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers in code / diff mode

wordWrap.description: Enable word-wrap in code / diff mode
wordWrap.label: Word Wrap
